english: Oh, looks like you found her. That Otsu girl...
Stop, Shinpachi! Mama Saigo hears that, you're in trouble...!
I said STOP, Shinpachi! Come on!
Want to be smashed to bits, bastard?! Look in a mirror first!
Don't say Otsu's name so casually!
Don't make me repeat myself! The likes of YOU...!
Cute girls are universal treasures. Alien or human, same thing.
Ugh! You... Um, d-did you find Otsu...?
Oh, h-hello... Looks like you found Otsu...
Comrade! Join us! Otsu's fan club!
Our love for Otsu is no different! So? Will you join?
Shinpachi... Who do you think you are...?

You found Terakado... Lady Otsu, I mean... How nice.

...No. Even Zura would probably pass on that.

Trying so hard... But we've questions about Gin Tama too.\fLet's go see him.

Tell me if you see Katsura. Please...
Hmm. If I feel like it.

Let's go see him. Come on, Gin?

Oh, the Joi lot. Need something?
Hmph. If I feel like it.
Hmph. Don't even WANT to see that Zura.
No, nothing... You're Katsura's friend, right?
Really? Thought you were off to see him now.
Found Katsura, then. Get to talk?

Definitely Katsura! Come on, Gin. Let's go!

No... Quitting's too much trouble too...
Ahh... Whatever. Don't care about anything...
What's this pathetic state?! You're meant to be Otsu's...!
No way... A member of Otsu's proud fan club?!
Not my problem! Do what you like!
Even if you say that... Doing what I like is too much trouble...
Even feeling lazy is too much effort...
Hey... I quit. Can't be bothered being a man of the sea...
Don't try stopping me... I've quit...
Never eating that stodgy yakisoba again?
Won't stop you. All for it, actually!
A playboy who can't be bothered to play!
Weird... Night's meant to be my favorite. Don't feel like anything...

You're NOT doing it! Heard you already!

Hehe... Can't be bothered with that sure thing catchphrase. At my age...
Fine, isn't it? Shop's probably closed today anyway.

Don't care what happens to the club...
Well, Saigo was in that state too...
Too much trouble. Disband the organization... No, wait. That's trouble too...\f...Forget it. Go with the flow.

But playing's too much trouble too... What to do...

Too lazy to play? You're a KID!
Just becomes a wall or fence.

Hey! You're young! What's that talk?!

Huh? The bike? Take it if you want...

...No, Kagura. That's just kelp. Plain kelp...

Replying's too much trouble. Don't talk to me, okay...?
